canon.note: AGENTS.md kit note cerydra: Military Merit/Peerage on strongest ally, Charge cap 8, Peerage at 6, Coup de Main copies carrier Skill (141202 notes), A1 +18% CRIT DMG per 100 ATK above 2000 (cap 360%), A3 +20 SPD, A4 CRIT Rate +100%, energyMax 130

fixtures.env: Duo E0 Cerydra + E0 Firefly (Firefly is the strongest ally = Merit carrier), Cerydra stats atk 3000/spd 165 (traces on: ATK+18% -> effAtk 3540, no SPD trace), energyStartFrac 0.5 (65/130 EN), Firefly stats atk 3000/spd 150 energyStartFrac 0 (talent floors to 120 EN), vs a dummy Elite (atk 0, Lightning-only weakness), 3 cycles. Rotation: Cerydra Skill grants Military Merit to Firefly -> Charge from carrier actions -> auto-Ult Scholar's Mate (+2 Charge) -> Carrier basic at Charge 6 upgrades to Peerage -> Carrier Skill fires Coup de Main copy and reverts Peerage (-6 Charge) -> Cerydra Basic King's Castling when SP is dry

requirements.claim: Basic 141201 'King's Castling' is Cerydra's SP-dry fallback (kit decide: SP < 1 -> basic), Wind basic hit.
Ultimate 141203 'Scholar's Mate' is the AoE Wind ult hit from the auto-ult turn.
Ultimate 141203 is cast from an auto-ult turn (charTurn full-energy rule, AGENTS 30-09-2026: energy 130/130 replaces the action).
Skill 141202 grants Military Merit to the strongest ally other than Cerydra (kit applyMerit, note 'grants Military Merit to Firefly').
Coup de Main (141202 notes: carrier uses Skill -> Cerydra copies that skill) fires a skill-type copy hit attributed to the carrier, label 'Coup de Main'.
Trace A4 grants Cerydra CRIT Rate +100% at battle start (kit onStart cerydra_crit, buffStat critRate = 1.0).
Trace A1 gives CRIT DMG +0.18 per 100 ATK above 2000 (cap 360%): effAtk = 3000 x (1 + 0.18 atkPct trace) = 3540 -> floor(1540/100) = 15 x 0.18 = 2.7 (kit onStart cerydra_cd).
Casting the auto-ult consumes the full 130 Energy pool (Energy.md canon: castUlt ENERGY_LOSS reason ult_cost, amount 130) and energy never exceeds the 130 cap afterwards.
Trace A3 grants +20 flat SPD to Cerydra and the Merit carrier after Skill (kit perform skill, buff cerydra_spd spdFlat = 20).
Military Merit must be granted (Cerydra Skill) before the talent follow-up 'Id Conservancy' can fire on the carrier's first attack.
Scholar's Mate (+2 Charge) resolves before Coup de Main: the ult turn precedes the carrier Skill that consumes Peerage.
Peerage auto-upgrade (Charge 6 -> 6+, kit maybePeerage note) must happen before Coup de Main, which only fires while the Peerage buff is active.
Peerage (cerydra_peer: Skill CRIT DMG + All RES PEN) is applied to the Merit carrier Firefly, not to Cerydra (kit maybePeerage target).
Military Merit gives the carrier flat ATK scaled from Cerydra's ATK (talent_a2 = 24% at L10 of Cerydra effAtk, buff cerydra_atk applied to Firefly via applyMerit).
E2 'carrier +40% DMG / Cerydra +160% DMG' buffs must never appear at E0 (kit eidolon guard).
